sections.bodyString: Made on our farm. USDA organic. At Hawthorne Valley Farm, we have been producing high-quality, nutritious foods for more than 35 years. Our farming practices reflect our commitment to protecting the health of the earth and all who live on it. Our education and outreach programs strive to raise awareness of the social, ecological, and economic importance of agriculture in our daily lives. Kids! Can! Cook! Summer Camp: A program of the Hawthorne Valley Farm Learning Center. Kids really can cook - and cooking opens doors to healthier lifestyles, connecting children to the wonder and beauty of nature while learning about nutrition, food, farming, and traditional crafts. Cooking, gardening, animal care, and swimming are all part of the experience. Kids! Can! Cook! is a summer day camp for children ages 8 to 13. For more information, please call 518-672-7500 x 232 or visit www.hawthornevalleyfarm.org. Hawthorne Valley Farm is part of Hawthorne Valley Association, a 501(c)3 not-for-profit organization. This yogurt is made in small batches on our farm with fresh, whole milk from our own herd and from select family farms in the area. We add no thickeners, solids, or fillers, and because the milk isn't homogenized there is a layer of delicious cream on top. Year round, we provide our cows with a natural, grass-based diet. During the growing season, the cows graze the pastures day and night, and in the winter they eat a mix of stored forages harvested from the farm. This careful management and tending, leads to happy cows, healthy soil, and delicious yogurt. We hope you enjoy it! Nurturing the land that nurtures us. Certified organic by Stellar Certification Services, Inc. www.hawthornevalleyfarm.org.

The cream ferments overnight and by morning, it's thickened and wonderful notes of buttermilk and hazelnuts have developed. Making cultured butter is much like making wine, you want to ferment your cream slowly just like your grapes. The longer you culture the better. sections.bodyString: Saffron is a native spice of Asia. Used since ancient times, it has remained highly prized for its unique taste and aroma, and the wonderful flavor it imparts to foods. Saffron is derived by picking the filaments or stigmas of a particular crocus plant, crocus sativus. It takes about 75,000 flowers to yield one pound of saffron. It is planted, picked, and sorted by hand, hence earning the title as the world's most exotic spice. Saffron is a natural spice whose flavor cannot be duplicated. Saffron is the traditional flavoring of many European dishes, such as French Bouillabaisse, Spanish Paella and Milanese Risotto, and is used extensively in middle eastern cookery. Fry your bologna for your sandwich or dice it up to throw in any dish. From egg omelettes to pastas, our sandwich meat can be enjoyed with every meal. Delicious Oscar Mayer Bologna deli meat slices are ideal for kids, on-the-go parents and busy adults. Fully cooked and ready to eat, our pre-sliced quality deli meats are ideal for making quick sandwiches for school or work lunches during the week, or family lunches and snacks on the weekend. Our thin cut sliced deli meat comes in a 12-ounce, 6-serving resealable package to ensure freshness. Store in the refrigerator and use within 7 days of opening. Partake makes inclusive foods that those with and without food allergies can enjoy. Their goodies are free from the top 9 food allergens, non-GMO, gluten-free, vegan, and bolster their work fighting food insecurity and supporting Black and female entrepreneurship. We’re excited to be partnering with them for this creamy, dreamy Non-Dairy flavor that elevates the oatmeal crème pie to stratospheric levels of dessert euphoria! Every bite has soft, chewy oatmeal cookie chunks that will have you wondering how they could possibly be gluten-free. Add in copious amounts of marshmallow swirls, and you have the recipe for vegan dessert perfection. It’s a modern take on the classic snack that has captivated cookie lovers for decades, and could easily become your next favorite scoop. Ben & Jerry's Vanilla ice cream pint with a chocolate cookie swirl, chocolate chip and chocolate chocolate chip cookies. Cookie madness, mixed with vanilla ice cream - has your inner cookie monster exploded with joy yet? It almost seems unfair to stack the deck like this. If the best part of your school day was sitting down to a plate of cookies and a glass of milk after you got home, is it fair to improve on that experience? We’d like to say no - but then this flavor came along. Not only do you get the perfect ratio of vanilla ice cream to cookie (no sogginess here!), you also get two kinds of cookies - regular old chocolate chip, and chocolate-chocolate chip. Oh, yes. We delved into the double-chocolate territory. And to make it even better, we also added a chocolate cookie swirl, just to maximize your cookie-eating experience. We’re sorry. (Just don’t tell your 8-year-old self that your favorite treat…just got even favorite-r). And we’ll admit: we also like playing favorites with ingredients, too. Which is why all of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream flavors are made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, and eggs from cage-free hens. In addition, the cocoa, sugar, and vanilla in Milk & Cookies come from Fairtrade certified producers - and this cookie-lover flavor also comes wrapped up in sustainably sourced packaging.

sections.bodyString:
Ben & Jerry's chocolate & caramel ice cream pint with fudge chips and a soft caramel core. Close your eyes and repeat after us: I deserve this. I deserve this. I deserve this. Can you visualize core euphoria yet? It’s easy to lose yourself in the sensuously sweet caramel core of Karamel Sutra and swim through its waves of caramel and chocolate ice cream. But the story of how this flavor came to be is nearly as sweet. In 2001, New York Times reporter Abby Ellin visited Ben & Jerry’s HQ in Burlington, VT, USA, with several other journalists. Each reporter worked with a Flavor Guru to invent their very own flavor. And although the recipe for Abby’s flavor was never committed to memory, her unforgettable name certainly stuck: Karamel Sutra! With Abby’s permission, Karamel Sutra joined our special collection of 2002 Core Concoction flavors. With its velvety core of soft caramel encircled by chocolate and caramel ice creams with fudge chips, this stuff was made for pint-tunnelers everywhere. So whether you dig straight down into the core or mix a bit of everything in each bite, tip your spoon to Abby and our Flavor Gurus as you savor this sultry blend. All of Ben & Jerry’s cocoa, sugar and vanilla comes from Fairtrade certified producers. Our ice cream is made with Non-GMO sourced ingredients, cage-free eggs, and we use responsibly sourced packaging.
